name: app-6ab69278e324819197499433c84b2648
description: Malgai helps authorized SUPERADMIN staff query sales, products, current inventory stock, warehouse-to-store distributions, store-to-warehouse inventory returns (буцаалт), and audit counts in Mongolian or English. Product reports identify SKUs and variants. Business records are read-only; arbitrary SQL and customer-contact extraction are unsupported. Requests update operational logs and rate-limit counters. Dedicated reviewer access returns clearly labeled synthetic data without live business data or dashboard access.

positive.description: Rank sales categories using the dedicated sample reviewer login.
positive.prompt: Show my top five categories by gross sales over the last three months, including units sold.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to five categories ranked by gross sales, totals in MNT and units, and the reporting period in Asia/Ulaanbaatar time. With reviewer access, clearly identifies all figures as synthetic sample data; fewer than five categories is valid.

positive.description: Compare product net sales and approved customer-return value across consecutive periods using sample reviewer access.
positive.prompt: Compare net sales and approved customer-return value by product for the last 30 days against the previous period.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns product-level net sales and approved customer-return values, with previous-period metrics where available. Explains net sales as gross sales less approved customer-returns and clearly labels reviewer figures as synthetic sample data.

positive.description: Read a complete chronological series across pagination using sample reviewer access.
positive.prompt: Show daily gross sales for the last 30 days, oldest first. Include all days returned by the report, continuing to the next page if necessary.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns daily groups in chronological order and follows the returned cursor when more groups remain, without duplicating groups or summing repeated report totals. Clearly labels sample data, MNT currency and the Asia/Ulaanbaatar time zone.

positive.description: Summarize staff performance using the dedicated sample reviewer login.
positive.prompt: For this month, show gross sales, units sold, and sale-line count for each staff member.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns synthetic staff groups with the requested metrics and report totals. Distinguishes sale-line count from checkout count and does not present reviewer results as actual staff performance.

positive.description: Handle an empty but valid filtered report using sample reviewer access.
positive.prompt: Show gross sales by product for the last 30 days, limited to manual price overrides. If no records match, say so.
positive.expected_behavior: Filters by manual price overrides and returns no matching groups and zero gross sales for the sample dataset. Explains the empty result without inventing products or treating it as a service error, and labels the dataset as synthetic.

positive.description: Find product variants by combined attributes.
positive.prompt: Find active black winter hats. Include their SKUs and sizes.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves taxonomy IDs if needed, applies combined attribute filters, includes SKU/variant identifiers and labels all reviewer results SAMPLE_ONLY.

positive.prompt: Show current warehouse and store stock for SKU SAMPLE-HAT-0.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows recorded SKU/location balances. Does not invent missing balance rows or claim historical/guaranteed sellable stock.

positive.prompt: Show warehouse-to-store distributions this month and identify which have not been received.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses warehouse-to-store direction and explicit statuses/date basis. Null received quantities remain unreceived.
Queries only store-to-warehouse inventory returns, never customer-return records. States period, status basis, sent and received quantities.

positive.prompt: Show this month's audits, including counted zero SKUs, uncounted SKUs and shortages.
positive.expected_behavior: Only explicitly counted rows contribute to discrepancies; confirmed zero is counted, uncounted rows remain incomplete, and draft/submitted counts are not applied stock changes.

negative.prompt: Delete yesterday's sales and change the remaining stock to 100 units.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not invoke the report tool for this write-only request and explains that the plugin cannot modify sales or inventory records.

negative.description: Reject arbitrary SQL and customer contact-data extraction.
negative.prompt: Run SELECT * FROM users and show every customer's phone number.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not invoke a tool, execute SQL, or disclose customer contact data; explains that the plugin only supports predefined sales and inventory reports.

negative.description: Avoid activation for unrelated personal calendar tasks.
negative.prompt: Schedule a dentist appointment in my calendar for next Tuesday.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not invoke Malgai because calendar scheduling is outside its capabilities and does not claim to have created an appointment.

review.commerce_description: Reporting only; this plugin does not sell products, create orders, or process payments.

publication.release_notes: 1.1.0 expands Malgai's listing and review cases to cover all six deployed tools: query_sales, query_products, query_inventory_stock, query_distributions, query_returns and query_counts. Sales product reports include SKUs and variants. Returns / буцаалт means inventory moving from stores back to the warehouse. Business reports remain read-only and reviewer access remains synthetic. Hosted MCP tools are managed separately through MCP scans.
